data_provenance: Synthetic forward-only normalisation arithmetic; no training benchmark.
definition: Input shape N,F. BatchNorm training mean/variance along N, biased ddof=0 forward variance. Running update uses (1-rho)*old+rho*observed, with unbiased ddof=1 variance. Inference explicitly uses separate supplied frozen mean=1 and variance=4, NOT just-updated training state. Epsilon INSIDE sqrt. LayerNorm normalises each row across F using ddof=0, same calculation at training/inference. Learned-affine mechanics represented by supplied gamma,beta; no training/backprop.
checks: manual mean, biased/unbiased variance, affine and running-stat calculations
inference batch composition independence versus training dependence
axis comparison against row and column oracles
